summary: Huangshan's official Natural Resources and Planning Bureau documents a local cadastral-investigation and real-estate-registration custodian, a full-territory cadastral database, and an internal cadastral information platform. An official municipal ArcGIS REST service listing was discovered, but its endpoint returned 502 through the research fetcher and DNS resolution failed for the direct shell request. No safe anonymous parcel identity plus full polygon was verified, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual URLs are recorded in city-11518-huangshan.json.
requestOutcomes: Official Natural Resources and Planning Bureau pages were readable through first-party search/open results. The official ArcGIS REST service URL was identified from first-party search, but opening the service returned 502 Bad Gateway; a TLS-default direct GET from the shell failed DNS resolution. The standard-map page was identified as map-download material, not a parcel-feature endpoint. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe field request or TLS exception was used.
